step1_analysis.circuit_type: VCO Delay Cell with Varactor Tuning and Bias Generation
step1_analysis.description: An inverting delay cell for a ring oscillator used in a PLL. It features cross-coupled active pull-down for hysteresis, MOS varactors (XM5, XM14) for delay tuning via a control voltage (VC), and a replica bias branch (XM7, XM12, XM13) to generate bias voltages for other blocks.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS 400-Mb/s Serial Link for AS-Memory Systems Using a PWM Scheme

propagation_delay.description: Time delay from input N4 crossing 50% to output N6 crossing 50%.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ~ C * V / I. C_load ~ 50fF (varactors + parasitic), V_swing ~ 0.9V, I_discharge ~ 300uA. Delay = 50fF * 0.9V / 300uA = 150ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V process; depends heavily on varactor capacitance and drive strength.

power_consumption.description: Average power dissipation of the delay cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: Static current dominated by diode stacks and pull-down networks. I_avg ~ 500uA. Power = 1.8V * 500uA = 0.9mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A single delay cell consumes a small fraction of the total transceiver power.

voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output node N6.

sky130_expected.calculation: Max voltage determined by PMOS/NMOS diode divider (~1.1V). Min voltage determined by pull-down strength (~0.4V). Swing = 1.1V - 0.4V = 0.7V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The diode-connected loads prevent the output from reaching full rail-to-rail swing.

bias_voltage_vn1.description: DC bias voltage generated at VN1 for other PLL blocks.

sky130_expected.calculation: Mirrored current from XM2 (~84uA) drives two diode-connected NMOS (XM12, XM13). V_VN1 = 2 * Vgs ~ 2 * 0.67V = 1.34V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the threshold voltage and mirrored current.

step3_testbench.description: Measures propagation delay, voltage swing, average power consumption, and generated bias voltages of the VCO delay cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Delay Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

XM1 N6 N4 N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N6 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 N6 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N9 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N6 VC N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VN1 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 N6 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N4 N4 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 VN1 VN1 VN2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 VN2 VN2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N6 VC N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVC VC 0 0.9
VIN N4 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 1n 2n)

* Prevent floating node errors for varactors
R_N8 N8 0 1G
R_N10 N10 0 1G

* Load capacitance
C_load N6 0 10f

.control
tran 10p 5n
meas tran delay_fall trig v(N4) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N6) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran delay_rise trig v(N4) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N6) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran v_max_N6 max v(N6) from=1n to=5n
meas tran v_min_N6 min v(N6) from=1n to=5n

meas tran avg_Ivdd avg i(VVDD) from=1n to=5n
let avg_power = -avg_Ivdd * 1.8
print avg_power

op
print v(VN1) v(VN2)
quit
.endc
